status: Selected final; generated and visually reviewed, not runtime-validated

generation.mode: built-in image_gen identity-preserve edit, then one background-only edit
generation.postprocessing: None on sprite. Byte-for-byte copy; original generated alpha preserved. White and gray composites are QA-only.

anchor_definitions.head: Estimated head bounding rectangle including ear tufts and beard: [x,y,w,h].
anchor_definitions.foot: Estimated common shoe-ground placement anchor near the lower sole baseline; not the stool anchor.
anchor_definitions.seat: Estimated seated pelvis/contact point over the stool, partly occluded.
anchor_definitions.hand: Central binding-knot interaction point; extra hand points identify the two cord-gripping hands.

coordinate_origin: All anchors are pixels relative to crop top-left [42,18] of the original canvas, not original-canvas coordinates and not normalized values.
estimate_caveat: All head, foot, seat, hand and notebook coordinates are visual estimates; require final visual confirmation after engine scaling and compositing. Alpha crop is measured. World placements are inherited candidate values only, not runtime-tested.

qa.review: Both white and gray alpha composites are clean with no visible background halo. Full head/ear tufts, feet and striped tail are in frame. Both hands grip loose binding cord over small worn notebook. Gaze points down toward hands; simple stool and approved clothing retained. No cane, scene, ground, or extra characters. Fine pixel edges are generated, not post-cleaned. Requested extra 5% margin was not substantially added; top margin is 18px and bottom margin is 31px, but nothing is clipped.
qa.raw_png_viewer_caveat: A raw image preview may display hidden RGB around an alpha-zero region. Transparency was judged with white and gray alpha composites and sampled alpha values, not the raw preview.

integration: Not uploaded, not delivered to Claude, and no game or app code changed.
